description:
Amazon's Agentic AI and Emerging Tech organization is building distributed systems and developer experience products used by engineers inside Amazon and by external customers. We are hiring a Software Development Engineer II to help create the next generation of AI-agent-driven automation, where intelligent agents take developer intent and autonomously plan, code, test, and deploy. In this role, you will own features end-to-end across the full software lifecycle and write high-quality, maintainable code that directly improves how engineers work. If you want to shape the tools and infrastructure that redefine software development, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement distributed systems and developer tooling across the full software lifecycle, including scoping, architecture, coding, testing, deployment, and operational support.
- Collaborate with product managers, stakeholders, and engineering peers to translate customer and business needs into well-defined technical requirements and working software.
- Identify root causes of operational issues and resolve them with permanent fixes, continuously improving system reliability and performance using AWS services such as Lambda, DynamoDB, and S3.
- Mentor fellow engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing, raising the technical bar across the team while producing clear documentation for the software you build.
- Evaluate and integrate generative AI capabilities where appropriate to augment productivity and solution quality, applying responsible practices to refine outputs and accelerate development.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing a design document for a new distributed systems feature, then jump into a code review where you help a teammate strengthen their approach. After a quick standup, you spend focused time writing and testing code for a developer experience capability you own. In the afternoon, you pair with a product manager to clarify requirements for an upcoming AI-agent workflow and wrap up by investigating an operational alert to identify its root cause and plan a permanent fix.

About the team
Our team sits within Amazon's Agentic AI and Emerging Tech organization, where we focus on building distributed systems and developer experience products that serve both internal Amazon engineers and external customers. We are working to automate the software development lifecycle through AI agents. We value collaboration, technical rigor, and getting the details right. Every engineer has the opportunity to influence our technical direction and contribute ideas that shape what we build. We maintain an inclusive environment where questions are welcomed and knowledge is shared freely.
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits . 


USA, WA, Seattle - 143,700.00 - 194,400.00 USD annually
